Found the game series originally on the app store and decided to buy the series in the bundle- so here are my thoughts on this game:

Concept is easy to understand; both characters have a secret side to them that they don't show the other, and eventually they find out and get together. Simple, right? The story is fairly easy, the game gives you indications on your choice type.

The artstyle is quite cute and so are the CG's for the particular routes you end up on and the voice acting also adds to how nice the game and story is.

I enjoyed it for the most part- did I think the price was worth every penny? maybe? maybe not? But it's defenitally a one time kinda game you'd play for the heck of it.

short in length, but the whole trilogy is that way, and honestly i like it that way. its well paced and a cute coming of age story, and it's a great introductory vn to the series! this game holds a special place in my heart as i grew up with it, and i find it quite comforting. id def recommend if ur looking for a nice, simple, sweet, and short visual novel to relax and read!

This is the first of a three part series designed like the free to play Holiday Otome series by Synokoria (avaliable for download on itch.io) with each game having a separate protagonist, as well as each squeal being a continuation of the world story told throughout. This means that in the later games, the relationship from the previous game, while no longer being the focus, are still present in the story, and you can see how their relationship pogresses on the side along with each new protagonist. However not only that, but the overall narration of both series, meaning the humor, drama, angst and fluff are all similar. 

All of that aside, this is a very good game. Not only the graphics, but the story as well. The series only has one love interest per game, but otherwise has all the other goodies of other well-known otome games. I genuinly have nothing bad to say about this game or the series as a whole. As for if you should get the origional or remastered version, other reviews have already laid out all you need to know for you to make the decision that is right for you. Happy simping everyone!

[b]How to Take Off Your Mask[/b] est un visual novel mignon et léger (F x M, avec un seul prétendant) qui prend approximativement [i]5 heures[/i] à terminer. (Mon temps de jeu est biaisé car j'ai perdu ma sauvegarde en changeant de pc (ce fut frustrant), donc il y a à enlever 3 heures de mon temps total.) La première route prend environ 3 heures à compléter avec une bonne vitesse de lecture, le reste se finit plus ou moins rapidement grâce à la lecture rapide. 

Nous suivons l'histoire de [i]Lilia[/i] et de son ami d'enfance [i]Ronan[/i]. La jeune fille se rend compte un jour qu'elle se réveille avec des oreilles et une queue de chat... Son corps a rapetissé aussi, nya! Nya? Sous cette forme elle ne peut s'empêcher de dire [i]Nya[/i]. Suite à ça nous suivons une intrigue fantastique dans un univers où les [i]Lucrétiens[/i] sont mal-vu par la société... Qu'adviendra-t-il de la pauvre [i]Lilia[/i]?! Et surtout, comment cela affectera sa relation avec son ami d'enfance...
Le visual novel se construit en [u]2 branches[/u] :
- La première où on suit + la partie humaine de [b]Lilia[/b].
- La deuxième où on suit + la partie Lucrétienne de [b]Leea[/b].
[b]How to Take Off Your Mask[/b] est le premier visual novel d'une [u]trilogie[/u].

Passons à une petite analyse !

♥ ♥ [u]Points positifs[/u] ♥ ♥
- Le VN est [b]mignon[/b], [b]léger[/b] et [b]rafraîchissant[/b], que ce soit au niveau de l'[i]histoire[/i], de la [i]direction artistique[/i] avec des personnages et des décors adorables. Très colorés pour la grande majorité des décors.
- La [b]musique[/b] du jeu est très bien travaillée. Nous avons un très beau générique (digne d'un anime) au chargement du jeu et  en fin de route, ça ne reste que mon opinion, mais c'est un de mes génériques de VN préférés, l'interprétation est vraiment réussit et il reste en tête ! (Vous pouvez déjà avoir un aperçu dans la deuxième vidéo de présentation de la page Steam.) Les OST tout au long du jeu sont très biens également et collent avec les situations du scénario.
- [b]Intégralement doublé[/b] ! Que ce soit l'héroïne, ou même les personnages les plus secondaires ! Le casting est très bon (surtout celle de [b]Leea[/b]) et on ne s'en lasse pas. 
- L'[b]intrigue[/b] fantastique est très prometteur. Si il n'y avait pas eu de suite à ce premier volet, j'aurais sans doute mis ce point dans point neutre, car ça fait qu'on se retrouve avec une histoire assez [b]courte[/b] (mais je n'ai [i]pas[/i] eu d'impression de [i]rush[/i]). Bien que la trame principale soit plus ou moins résolu à la fin des deux routes, il reste encore différentes questions en tête. Notamment [spoiler]Qui est donc le "grand méchant" dans cette histoire? Que veut-il? Où sont les parents de Lilia?[/spoiler] J'ai bon espoir de trouver mes réponses dans les opus suivants.
- Ce VN alterne entre un humour léger et un ton plus sérieux, et c'est bien maîtrisé. 
- Les [b]CG[/b] sont très beaux !
- Beaucoup de slot de sauvegardes. Vraiment beaucoup. C'est beau pour les yeux ! (Même si à mon avis, vous n'aurez même pas besoin de la moitié !)
- Les [b]achievements[/b] s'obtiennent plus ou moins facilement.

- ♥ [u]Points neutres[/u] - ♥
Bien que je ne lui ai pas demandé, mon jeu a été mis par défaut en français. Alors je n'ai rien contre le français étant bah.. française, sauf que j'ai l'habitude de jouer mes visual novel en anglais. Donc je jugerais ici la qualité de l'écriture française.
- La [b]traduction[/b] est bonne. Par moment j'ai tiqué un petit peu mais sinon c'était très bien, et ça avait même un certain charme et on arrive à comprendre et à suivre l'histoire.

- - [u]Points négatifs[/u] -- 
- [strike]J'ai perdu mes sauvegardes et j'ai du recommencé depuis le début, ouiiin. Je rigole, évidemment![/strike]
Plus sérieusement, je trouve très peu de points négatifs. 

[h1]Conclusion ?[/h1]
Je conseille ce VN à toutes celles et ceux qui veulent se lancer dans la franchise [i]Eroolia[/i]/la trilogie des [i]How to[/i]. Moi-même à l'écriture de cet avis je n'ai pas encore joué aux deux suivants (ce que je me dépêcherais de faire!), mais ce premier épisode m'a grandement convaincu.
Si vous cherchez un visual novel mignon et sans prise de tête, foncez pour celui-là !
Je recommanderais cependant d'acheter la version [i]Remastered[/i] du jeu, qui ajoute des petits plus au jeu. Et ce sera également plus rentable au niveau du prix. (Si vous voulez tout de même achetés cette version, je conseillerais de l'acheter en [i]promotion[/i], le jeu est de bonne qualité, cependant il parait bien élevé comparé au prix de [i]Remaster[/i].)

Grę kupiłam parę ładnych lat temu i postanowiłam w nią zagrać jeszcze raz - bo mi się nudziło i chciałam zdobyć wszystkie osiągnięcia.
Wynudziłam się strasznie.
Grafika nie jest najgorsza, jest w porządku, ale niczego mi nie urywa. Widziałam tysiące ładniejszych gier otome. Jednak jak pisałam, nie jest też zła.
Co do fabuły, jestem nią zawiedziona. Miała potencjał na coś lepszego, większego. Zdaję sobie sprawę z tego że ta gra nie miała być prawdopodobnie jakaś niesamowita, ambitna. Ale żeby tak chamsko zamknąć wątki? A bardziej je urwać w połowie? Aby nie spoilerować za bardzo, napiszę tylko: po co poruszać i zaczynać wątki pod koniec gry? Czuję mocny nie dosyt po rozgrywce.
Przechodząc dalej, bohaterowie. O zgrozo, główni bohaterowie mnie denerwowali. Ronan był do wytrzymania, ale o wiele bardziej zainteresował mnie Julai (może dlatego, że uwielbiam w serialach i grach postacie narcystyczne, huh). Ubolewam trochę nad tym, że mamy tylko opcję poznania Ronana. Jednak, to jest do przeżycia. Mówi się trudno. 
Jednak MC. Cieszy mnie, że nie była ona typową słabą postacią, która czeka na swojego rycerza na białym koniu. Jednak mimo wszystko mnie irytowała. Może innym przypadnie do gustu, mi jednak nie. Naprawdę, w swojej ludzkiej wersji robiła fochy o wszystko.
Gdy byłam młodsza, może nawet podobała mi się ta gra. Grając w to, odnosiłam niezmierne wrażenie, że to właśnie gra dla młodszych, oczekujących wiele romantycznych scen.

[h1]Посредственность[/h1]

Перед нами незамысловатая визуальная новелла жанра "отоме". 
По [b]сюжету[/b] мы играем за девушку-пекаря Лилию, которая живет с бабушкой и работает в пекарне. Она очень дорожит общением со своим другом детства, о котором заботится, как о младшем брате. В один прекрасный день Лилия превращается в кошкодевочку, которых в этом мире называют "Лукреции". По непонятным причинам в этом мире кошкодевочек дискриминируют и боятся, так мы и попадаем с Лилией в различные ситуации. На этом собственно завязка сюжета заканчивается. Сам сюжет очень простой и плохо проработанный. Почему Лукреций боятся в этом мире? Ничего нам не объясняют. Повествование наивное и поверхностное. 

[b]Герои[/b]. В данной игре нам предлагают только один любовный интерес - друг детства ГГ. И хотя он довольно милый, все равно герои часто ведут себя глупо. Например, ГГ ревнует к самой себе в другой форме. Также смущает поведение ГГ. В разных формах она ведет себя как совершенно другой человек. Такая непоследовательность повествования сбивает с толку. Любовная линия банальная донельзя. Откройте любую мангу, посмотрите любое аниме, где любовный интерес это "друг/подруга детства" и вы получите ровно такой же, клишированный сюжет. 

[b]Музыка и арты[/b] Рисовка довольна милая и приятная. Музыка не хорошая, но и не слишком раздражающая. В целом ничего выдающегося.

Вся новелла - это середнячок, ничем не выделяющейся среди множества других новелл. У нее нет ярких плюсов и множество мелких, но раздражающих минусов. Пропустив ее, вы совершенно ничего не потеряете. За эту цену можно найти новеллы на порядок лучше и качественнее. Если очень сильно хочется поиграть за взбалмошную кошкодевочку, то хотя бы подождите скидки.

Eu me sinto enganada. Comprei o jogo no escuro, sem saber muito da história além do que fora oferecido na descrição, e nunca que imaginei que um jogo com uma arte tão bonitinha e uma música tão fofinha fosse ter uma rota que envolveria uma garota de 12/14 anos com um homem adulto.
O jogo começou bem interessante, sim, o enredo é completamente clichê e os personagens exemplos de esteriótipos, mas a história por trás de tudo acabou sendo cativante. Entretanto, minha opinião mudou completamente quando iniciei a rota como luccretia, como assim vocês fazem uma personagem maior de idade que se transforma numa criança? E ainda tem a cara de pau de fazer ela se envolver romanticamente com um cara? Eu praticamente pulei a maior parte da rota dela a partir do capítulo 5, pois aquilo não era romance, era nojento.
Eu estava doida para comprar os outros dois jogos, já que o terceiro dessa série me deixou bastante curiosa, porém eu vou repensar sobre isso. E eu não recomendo isso a ninguém, ficou curioso e quer jogar? Pula esse, busca um resumo na internet ou pelas próprias resenhas, mas pula esse, não vai aderir em nada na lore desse mundo, já que serve apenas como uma pequena e rasa introdução.

Outros pontos que me incomodaram durante o jogo foram:
- Preço muito elevado para algo que me custou em torno de quatro horas.
- Poucas escolhas, que ainda levam tudo ao mesmo resultado de qualquer forma.
- A escrita em si, utilizando de kaomojis. Também tem as partes que em vez de descrever a situação ou reação da personagem, colocavam simplesmente um "*cry*".
- Finais que não aderem em nada a história. Lilia fica no escuro sobre a própria família e não parece preocupada em saber sobre o estado de seus pais depois que consegue seu "amor".

Esperava mais desse jogo, já que de alguma forma ele rendeu outros dois (onde Lilia e Ronan são secundários), mas foi uma decepção e tanto.

Now that I have finished the game and 100% the achievements, I am writing this review. The whole novel is 3 core chapters with 3 more chapters for each of 2 different story trees, the human side and the cat girl side.  There is also bonus stories for each chapter, and a secret bonus story that can be unlocked by completing both stories in one sitting (might need to use the replay with skip feature).

I love this story. The characters are adorable. The mystery of the town is intriguing.  Obviously, I finished both story sides in under 8 hours, but it was well worth it. This was a good visual novel overall. It was very cute and had great voice acting and fluffy romance. To my relief, it was easy to play through all the story paths and endings. I enjoyed both main story branches but found that I preferred the Human Side (story branch in which Lilia is primarily in human form) over the Luccretia Side (story branch in which she's primarily in luccretia form). Although Lilia [spoiler]behaved more honestly while in luccretia form (and was just plain cuter), in the Human Side she was more honest with Ronan overall, and I really liked that. That honesty was reflected in how the ending played out too, and it just worked better for me overall.[/spoiler]

Pros:
+ Excellent voice acting. All dialogue is voiced (characters' thoughts are not), and I liked everyone's voice but the villain's. Although I tended to read faster than the actors spoke, I found myself waiting for them to finish talking before moving on to the next line, because I liked their voices so much.
+ The story was a bit bland and predictable, but it was so cutely executed that I mostly didn't notice. I liked Ronan and, although she was occasionally frustrating, I liked Lilia too. It was fun watching them gradually realize their feelings for each other.
+ The story wasn't rapey! That said, it did have some other issues I've covered in my "cons" section.
+ I loved the sprites, and the CG artwork was usually pretty nice too.
+ Very easy to go through all the story options. Choices have two types of effects: raising your chance of getting the Human Side vs. the Luccretia Side, and raising your romance (I'm not sure how necessary this is - I never tested what effect choosing nothing but non-romance options would get you). You only ever have to choose between two possible options, and the effects of your choices are immediately made clear with a little image that appears. Also, the game makes it crystal clear which story paths you've already followed and allows players to start off at whichever chapter (that they've previously played) that they'd like. This would be a great first visual novel for newbies.

Cons:
- The story was pretty bland and predictable after a certain point.
- Although Lilia is an adult (or maybe older teen?) in human form, she's physically only 13 or 14 in luccretia form. Which means that, especially in the Luccretia Side, Ronan finds himself growing increasingly attracted to a child. Granted, even he has problems with this and fights his feelings, but the Luccretia ending has him deciding that it's okay to love her no matter her form because Lilia's mental age in that form is older. I kind of agreed with him, but the justification still felt a bit icky.
- The translation was occasionally a bit rough, with a few misused words and awkward phrases here and there.

All in all I'm glad I've already purchased [i]How to Fool a Liar King[/i]. I'm looking forward to playing that one too.

A friend bought me the game but after playing all routes and getting all achievements in only 4 hours I couldn't recommend this game at full price.

The storyline:
+ interesting concept, acceptable flow of events
- too many (major) plotholes at the end
The store description is quite spot on. Protagonist Lilia suddenly transforms into some catlike human and tries to hide that fact from her best friend / kinda little brother while trying to find out why he never told her, that he works as a guard. Throw in some racism against catpeople and hidden romantic feelings and that's the overall plot.
While it sounds interesting at first, I couldn't manage to oversee a certain lack in depth in the story. There are topics that should play a large role that get pushed to the background by the romantic problems of the mains, leaving the reader with some unsolved plotholes. At the end I still have a lot of questions unanswered and that shouldn't be.

The characters:
+ good-looking designs, also nice concepts
- too cliché, most lack a lot character depth
The characters all look nice but they just lack in a lot of things. For example, the main: Being transformed into a catgirl changes her character, which is a good explanation for the different ways she can react. It's also interesting to see, how her behaviour changes depending on which side you lean to. But either way she is pretty much a walking stereotype. You either get your typical "I can do it myself (no you can't)" heroine or the shy "I need a hug" girl. No matter which you chose, she still is too accepting of things. Revelations that should blow her mind (because facts told to her for years suddenly turn out to be lies) were just accepted like "Oh, okay, that's that now, i guess".
The other characters aren't really better. Most of them had a lot of potential which wasn't used and sometimes I just wondered why they were doing what they did instead of something that - after knowing everything about them - should have been a lot more logical.

Voices, Sounds etc:
+ japanese voice actors were really good, music & sounds were nice
- not a lot of different music tracks which made the music go repetitive very fast
I liked the voices. You really could hear the emotions and, especially in voiced VNs, nothing is better than actors not sounding like dead beaten fishes. The music was nice, too, but it had just 9 or so tracks which was very repetitive after a short while but I guess it's acceptable.

All in all it isn't a bad game. I was entertained for a little while but it just wasn't long enough. A lot of VNs on Steam for the same price (or just a bit more) get you 20+ hours of playtime for all routes, which keep you interested in the story. This game however does not. You only have one guy and only two different routes. That plus the acceptable but not outstanding plot just isn't worth the full price.

Well, just got done playing the human side route. I must say, this game is very adorable! I highly recommend this game if you are a fan of visual novels.

Pros:
*Character sprites are VERY well done. The shading and proportions are excellent, and don't make me feel like I'm looking at a newgrounds flash game made by a 14 year old. 
*Very well written story. Dialogue is well done, the chraracters, while not very in depth, I feel are quite decently written.
*Gameplay does not appear to have any bugs at all
*This game does appear to have some replay value
*This game is fully voiced, even the minor characters (all two of them). Voices are in Japanese.

Cons:
*This game is rather short (I am a huge speed reader, so actual gameplay was less than an hour for me. Then again, I can read a 600 page book in two hours). If you are a slower reader, I imagine this would take a bit longer.
*The story, while well written, could use a bit of fleshing out. I guess I just like more details and meat to a story.
*Price does feel a bit high to me. Then again, this is probably because of the voice acting.
*Plotline seems to skip around a bit, but given this is a light-hearted story, it doesn't really detract from anything.


All in all, if you love visual novels and reading, this is a good game. If you are a huge otome and VN fan like me, you won't mind the price. Otherwise, you may want to wait until this goes on sale.
